scripts.lint: biome ci . && node scripts/check-layers.ts && node scripts/check-contract-words.ts && node scripts/check-prompts.ts
scripts.ci:lint: biome ci . && node scripts/check-layers.ts && node scripts/check-contract-words.ts && node scripts/check-prompts.ts

scripts.ci:acceptance: node scripts/build.ts --out .build/ci-acceptance && COHORTE_E2E_BUILD_DIR=.build/ci-acceptance vitest run --project e2e tests/acceptance
